$comment: Every version of this distribution that EXISTS on the private index, wherever
it was published from, and whether or not it may be pinned.
Renamed from inherited-releases.json on 2026-08-30. The old name stopped
covering the file's job the moment this repository published one of its own:
the release floor is derived from everything here, and a version published
HERE bounds the floor exactly as an inherited one does. Keeping the old name
and adding a non-inherited row would have made the filename a lie.
`pinnable = false` means the version exists permanently and must never be
depended on. That is not the same as absent, and the distinction is the whole
reason this file lists it: an index cannot un-publish, so the only place a
'do not pin this' fact can live is here and in the guard that reads it.

releases.release_run_note: Not recorded in the dossier at extraction time. Absent rather than guessed: a run id invented to fill the field would be a coordinate that resolves to nothing.

Tagged only after the wheel was installed back from the private index and conformance-checked. a2 rather than a1 is the first admissible composition version: a1 published the stable-verdict contract but did not recover the losing first-arrival transaction after the receipt unique constraint selected a winner.

releases.tag_note: NOT TAGGED, and must not be. A tag is this repository's assertion that a release was verified; a3's verification returned UNPROVABLE.
releases.release_run_note: Published by a run cancelled during its own verify job: the upload succeeded, the read-back, consumer proof and tag never ran. Verify run 33296262948 returned UNPROVABLE on property 1 — the sdist was never retrieved or compared by any automated check. Both artifacts were LATER confirmed byte-correct out of band (wheel 45,911 bytes, sdist 42,256 bytes, both sha256-matching the release run's build), so the BYTES are sound and the EVIDENCE CHAIN is not. Michael ruled 2026-08-30: immutable, unprovable, never pinnable, superseded by a4.
